note: _dum vinceret filios Israhel_ – when he would have defeated the sons of Israel; quand il aurait vaincu les fils d’Israël; sobald er die Israeliten besiegt habe. In classical Latin, it would be _cum vicisset_. Albert Blaise: _Manuel du latin chrétien_. Strasbourg 1955 (221 pp.), p. 175 (§ 311).
